title: Lubricant (Lube)
summary: Lube is a slippery gel or liquid that reduces friction during sex or masturbation. It makes sex more comfortable and helps condoms not break.
key_points: Water-based and silicone lubes are safe with all condoms.
Oil, lotion or petroleum jelly damage latex condoms.
Silicone lube can damage silicone toys; water-based is safest for toys.
